Short, messy jet black hair with long side-locks and blunt bangs. Sharp, narrow golden-yellow eyes with a predatory expression. Apparent age is a teenager with a youthful face. Petite, slender build. Signature outfit is a dark navy blue and grey sailor-style dress with a white collar and a short black capelet. Signature details include a small black headset with a red light and a long, thick black mechanical submarine-style tail with a fin.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
